🧠 DAILY SMC MARKET MAP — EURUSD + GOLD

Fresh market data | Daily → 4H → 1H → 15M
No setup is an entry until 15M confirmation occurs.

🔥 STRONGEST SETUP — XAUUSD SELL
Current: ~$4,135

HTF READ
• Daily structure remains bearish after the rejection from the ~$4,184 area and the broader decline from the September highs.
• 4H structure is bearish; price rejected ~$4,184 and is now pressing back toward the ~$4,133–$4,108 liquidity area.
• 1H structure is making lower highs/lower lows.
• Current price is already near the downside objective, so chasing the move is poor R:R.

🎯 PRIMARY SHORT
Wait for a retracement into $4,145–$4,160, then require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ $4,133
→ $4,115
→ $4,108

Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~$4,169.
Stronger structural invalidation above ~$4,184.

🟠 EURUSD SELL — CONDITIONAL
Current: ~$1.1234

HTF READ
• Daily structure remains bearish following the broader rejection from the 1.1375 area.
• 4H rallied into ~1.1279 and then rejected sharply.
• 1H/15M are now rolling over after the corrective recovery.
• The current price is already below the preferred short zone, so wait for the retracement rather than chase.

🎯 PRIMARY SHORT
Wait for a retracement into 1.1245–1.1252, then require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ 1.12285
→ 1.12023
→ 1.11870

Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~1.1266.
Stronger structural invalidation above ~1.1279.

⚠️ MACRO RISK
Markets are focused on the Federal Reserve's September meeting minutes today. Gold is particularly sensitive to changes in Treasury yields, the dollar and expectations for further rate hikes. Reuters reports spot gold around $4,150 earlier today with a mild downside bias, while EUR/USD has stabilised somewhat above $1.1250 after the French bond-market stress eased.

⚠️ SMC VERDICT
XAUUSD SELL is the cleaner setup, but only on a retracement into 4,145–4,160.
EURUSD SELL is also valid conditionally, with 1.1245–1.1252 as the preferred POI.
Do not chase either move at current levels.

Educational market analysis — not financial advice.
